verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented rules engine or workflow automation that lets users define conditions which trigger actions on events. Payment notifications (HTTP POST to a Notification URL, with retries) are only an event-delivery building block: the merchant would have to build the rule logic outside EBANX. Vendor-managed 'smart retry logic' and recurring Pix automatic debit are adjacent features, not user-defined event rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: EBANX sends an HTTP POST request to the configured Notification URL.
